_note: Every value here is a protocol parameter with a published source. Changing any of them changes a study endpoint. Bump paramsVersion, record the countersignature, and never edit mid-camp.

routing._source: Merkel 1997 (FLACC); Hicks 2001 (FPS-R, validated 4-12y); von Baeyer 2009 (NRS-11 from age 8); Malviya 2006 (r-FLACC).
routing._basis: The clinical form records age in completed MONTHS, not a birth date. That is both simpler at the bedside and better for data protection: months are not a direct identifier, so the workbook stops being an identifiable dataset. Routing thresholds are therefore expressed in months; the year-based values remain for anything still holding a date.

painBands._source: Serlin 1995; applied to pediatric self-report per von Baeyer. Common metric across FLACC, FPS-R and NRS.

thresholds.irrKappaSource: Landis & Koch, Biometrics 1977 (lower bound of 'almost perfect')
thresholds.clusterSource: Nagin & Odgers, Annu Rev Clin Psychol 2010

breakthroughPain._definition: bt_pain_24h = 1 if, within windowHours of anaesthesia end, any rest or dynamic score >= scoreThreshold, OR any PRN rescue analgesic administered.

rebound._note: Both definitions are derived from the same rows. rebound_protocol is primary; rebound_barry is reported for external comparability.

barry._source: Barry et al., Br J Anaesth 2021

localAnaesthetic._source: ESRA/ASRA joint practice advisory, Ivani et al., Reg Anesth Pain Med 2015. Single-shot maxima.
localAnaesthetic.infantReductionNote: Reduce by 30% under 6 completed months for immature hepatic clearance and low alpha-1-acid glycoprotein.

mme._source: CDC 2022 Clinical Practice Guideline conversion table. Factors convert an administered dose to oral morphine milligram equivalents.

fentanylEquivalents._note: Intraoperative opioid load, expressed as mcg fentanyl equivalents.

restrictedDrugs._source: FDA 2017 safety communication: CYP2D6 ultra-rapid metaboliser risk.
restrictedDrugs._behaviour: Never blocks. The entry is recorded because refusing to record what happened corrupts the dataset; it is flagged to _qc for same-shift PI review.

respiratoryDepression._definition: Any one trigger opens M8 with the event pre-classified and raises the severity banner.

assessmentSchedule._note: Five ward timepoints, per the clinical form. Fewer, wider-spaced points that ward staff can realistically hit beat a dense grid that gets half-filled.

dataCapture._note: Assessments will not always be entered at the bedside. Patient-to-clinician ratios, emergencies and ward logistics mean some are written on paper and typed up later, and a few are reconstructed from recall. That is a fact about the study, so it is recorded as a variable rather than hidden: entry_mode is a data-quality covariate and belongs in the analysis, not in a footnote.
dataCapture._basis: A FLACC score reconstructed from memory is weaker evidence than one scored at the cot side. Sensitivity analyses should be able to exclude it.

privacy._note: Enforced by tests/schema.test.js. A build fails if any form outside identifierAllowedForms declares a field in identifierFields.

paedSchedule._note: PACU emergence assessment. PAED >= 10 with non-purposeful thrashing indicates emergence delirium rather than pain.

formOptions._note: Exactly the choices on the clinical form. Keep them identical — a dropdown that does not match the paper is a transcription error waiting to happen.
